question: What attainment makes a practitioner beloved to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment.
Such accomplishment can belong to a practitioner.
Possessing this accomplishment leads to being dear to the yoginīs.
inference: A practitioner endowed with the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
